captions.detailed: A cold-press smoothie blender featuring a wide, rectangular black base with a grey control dial on the side. Mounted on top is a transparent, wide-mouth polycarbonate jar with an integrated side handle and a bottom bayonet-style coupling. Inside the jar sits a grey six-blade cross assembly, and the top is sealed with a thick black screw-top cap that has a small red indicator on its center dial.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a cold-press smoothie blender. The model should include a wide rectangular black base with a control dial on the side, a transparent wide-mouth jar with a side handle, a six-blade cross assembly inside the jar, and a black screw-top cap on top.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by defining several parts. The base is created using a Box primitive for the body and a Cylinder for the side dial, colored black and grey respectively. The jar is constructed with a hollowed-out rectangular box, a cylindrical bottom coupling, and a side handle made of extruded boxes, using a semi-transparent blue-grey material. The blade assembly is modeled with a central cylinder and six angled rectangular blades. Finally, the top cap is constructed using a flat cylinder with a smaller top dial and a red indicator strip.
